title: KaiserBad Ellmau
highlights: Modern water adventure and wellness resort situated directly at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser
Expansive poolscape featuring a lazy river torrent, grottos, and whirlpool loungers
Thrilling waterslide complex with high-speed turbo slide and Black Hole tunnel
Unique sauna world commanding views of the rugged Kaiser rock faces
kurzbeschreibung: KaiserBad Ellmau delights visitors with adventure pools, giant water slides, an organic swimming pond, and a sauna village against the Kaiser backdrop.
beschreibung:
Water Fun and Relaxation at the Wilder Kaiser

The KaiserBad Ellmau is one of the most attractive leisure pools in Tirol. Located directly at the foot of the prominent Kaisergebirge, the complex combines all-weather indoor swimming fun with a generous summer outdoor area including an ecological organic swimming pond.

Slide Paradise and Alpine Wellness

Brave water enthusiasts plunge down the turbo slide or the 92-metre-long giant water slide, while the lazy river current channel and water cannons provide plenty of variety. In the sauna village featuring log cabin saunas, steam baths, and cold-water plunge pools, relaxation seekers recharge their energy.
